title: Building Controls
lede: Building automation design, integration, and service — from a single VAV box's sequence to a campus-wide Niagara migration. The controls layer is our front door, not a sideline.
metaDescription: Building automation and controls integration from Charlotte Temperature Controls — Reliable Controls Authorized Dealer, Niagara, Tridium, BACnet across North and South Carolina.

partners.heading: A Reliable Controls Authorized Dealer.
partners.body: We partner with Reliable Controls — a Canadian-built, BACnet-native platform that integrates cleanly with whatever else lives in your building. Reliable's tools, our experience installing them. That's the formula.

featuresHeading: Controls work that pays for itself.
featuresLead: A well-tuned controls system cuts energy spend 10-20% on day one. We design, install, and tune systems that keep delivering — not ones that drift back to defaults six months later.

features.body: Reliable Controls, Tridium Niagara N4, JCI Metasys, Siemens Desigo, Distech, Automated Logic — we lead with open BACnet, no proprietary lock-in.

features.body: BACnet IP/MSTP, Modbus TCP/RTU, LonWorks, MQTT — interoperable systems you can extend or replace without ripping it all out.

features.body: Existing systems audited, sequences re-tuned, drifted setpoints corrected — recover the savings the original design promised.

whyHeading: Three decades of controls. And a service van outside.
whyParagraphs: We came up as a controls house in 1988 and grew into mechanical service from there — not the other way around. Controls isn't an add-on for us; it's the front door.

Our controls group spans installation, integration, and analytics. We hand off systems your in-house facilities team can actually operate and maintain — with documentation that matches what's in the panel.
whyBullets: Manufacturer training on JCI, Siemens, Distech, Automated Logic
Graphics + sequence documentation delivered with every project
Hands-on training for your facility team
Remote support — we can dial into your system before sending a truck
ctaParagraph: Whether it's a single-building retrofit, a Niagara N4 migration, or a campus rollout — we can scope, design, install, and program. And stay around to keep it tuned.
